title.ja: 閉ざされた本道と、歪んだ真鍮
title.en: The Blocked Road and Deformed Brass

quote.ja: これで、わたしの届けてきたものは、四十三。
quote.en: With this, the number of people whose belongings I have returned is forty-three.

mood.ja: 指先が覚えている真鍮の冷たさと、行く手を阻む冬の気配
mood.en: The coldness of brass lingering on my fingertips, and the approach of winter blocking my way
